title: Basic-auth admin bootstrap runs in the mlflow server CLI process before workers spawn
answers: mlflow server basic-auth keeps restarting workers forever
uvicorn worker crash loop when admin password is missing
why is admin user created before the server starts
mlflow server exits with one error instead of endless restarts
body:
Symptom: `mlflow server --app-name basic-auth` with no admin password configured keeps respawning workers in a loop instead of exiting with one clear error.
Root cause: The admin bootstrap ran inside create_app in every uvicorn worker, so a raised error while loading the app makes the multiprocess supervisor restart the worker endlessly.
Fix pattern: _run_server calls _bootstrap_basic_auth (which calls bootstrap_admin_user) in the CLI process before any worker is spawned. It then sets _MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED in env_map, so workers skip the redundant bootstrap and the PBKDF2 legacy-password checks.
Constraints: create_app still bootstraps when used outside the CLI (the flag is absent). Put any new fail-fast auth startup check in bootstrap_admin_user so it runs in the CLI. _MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED is internal and must not be set by users. A missing MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY still crash-loops; this is pre-existing and not covered here.
applies: The `mlflow server` CLI path for `--app-name basic-auth`, with any worker count.
says: The server enters an endless worker restart loop when the administrator password is missing.
Server startup should exit immediately with an error message instead of continuously restarting workers.
Launching the server with basic authentication crashes repeatedly when required admin setup is incomplete.
Provide a clear failure message during startup rather than getting stuck in crash loops.
search: When starting mlflow server with basic-auth, admin bootstrapping runs in the CLI process before uvicorn workers spawn to prevent endless crash loops. _run_server invokes _bootstrap_basic_auth and bootstrap_admin_user in the main CLI process and sets _MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED in env_map so worker processes skip duplicate bootstrap and PBKDF2 checks. create_app still bootstraps when executed outside the CLI, while new fail-fast startup checks belong in bootstrap_admin_user. The internal variable _MLFLOW_AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED must not be set by users, and crash loops caused by a missing MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY remain unaddressed.
